# API

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api-doc.py from the ROUTES table in
     server.py. Do not edit by hand: run the script. -->

Two unrelated identities. A **browser session** (cookie plus CSRF token) reaches
the view and edit routes. The **ingest key** (`X-Ingest-Key`) reaches the ingest
routes and nothing else. Compromising one grants nothing of the other.

Any path not listed here is a 404. Authorisation is declared per route, so a new
route is unreachable until it says what it needs.

## Auth — none / session

Signing in and out, and the Google OAuth flow.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/auth/login` | Open a session. Returns the CSRF token to send on every mutation |
| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | End this session |
| GET | `/api/auth/whoami` | The signed-in user, or 401 |
| POST | `/api/setup/claim` | Claim a fresh install with the setup token. Closes once a user exists |
| GET | `/api/auth/google/start` | Begin the Google OAuth flow (PKCE) |
| GET | `/api/auth/google/callback` | OAuth callback. Exchanges the code and stores the tokens encrypted |

## Setup and status — none

Reachable without a session. Neither returns personal data.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/health` | Liveness. No authentication, no data |
| GET | `/api/config` | Whether setup is complete and which features are configured |
| GET | `/api/theme` | The active theme's tokens. Readable before sign-in; colours only |

## View — session

Reads. No CSRF token needed.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/view/home` | The combined home screen payload |
| GET | `/api/view/overview` | Totals across accounts |
| GET | `/api/view/budget` | The month's envelopes, activity and balances |
| GET | `/api/view/suggestions` | Suggested budget figures from your own statement history |
| GET | `/api/view/agenda` | Events for the agenda panel |
| GET | `/api/view/calendar` | Events for the month grid |
| GET | `/api/view/inbox` | Scored mail, most important first |
| GET | `/api/view/message/{id}` | A message body, fetched on demand and cached, HTML stripped |
| GET | `/api/view/status` | Last sync, pending pushes and any error |
| GET | `/api/view/transactions` | Transactions, filtered |
| GET | `/api/view/transaction/{id}` | Everything known about one charge, including the bank's fuller description and the line it arrived on |
| GET | `/api/view/unfiled` | Rows with no category yet |
| GET | `/api/view/ledger` | The full hierarchical ledger view |
| GET | `/api/view/transfers` | Linked transfers and candidate pairs |
| GET | `/api/view/history` | Import batches and what they covered |
| GET | `/api/view/coverage` | Which months each account has statements for |
| GET | `/api/image` | Fetch a remote image the server signed. Signature required |

## Edit — session + CSRF

Every mutation needs the `X-CSRF-Token` header from login.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/edit/event` | Create an event locally and queue the push |
| PATCH \| DELETE | `/api/edit/event/{id}` | Edit or delete an event |
| PATCH | `/api/edit/message/{id}` | Star, read, archive, trash or spam a message |
| PATCH \| DELETE | `/api/edit/transaction/{id}` | Edit or delete one transaction |
| POST | `/api/edit/by-payee` | File every row for one merchant at once |
| GET \| POST \| DELETE | `/api/edit/transaction/{id}/split` | Read, create or remove a transaction's split parts |
| POST \| DELETE | `/api/edit/transfer` | Link two rows as one transfer, or unlink |
| PATCH | `/api/edit/budget/{month}/{id}` | Set one envelope's amount for a month |
| POST | `/api/edit/budget/{month}/move` | Move budgeted money between envelopes |
| GET \| POST | `/api/categories` | Categories: list, or create |
| PATCH \| DELETE | `/api/categories/{id}` | Rename, move, hide or delete a category |
| GET \| POST | `/api/category-groups` | Category groups: list, or create |
| GET \| POST | `/api/accounts` | Ledger accounts: list, or create |
| POST | `/api/categorize` | Categorise every unfiled row, deduplicated by merchant |

## Import — session + CSRF

A statement is parsed and staged for review; nothing reaches the ledger until the batch is committed, and a commit can be undone.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/import/upload` | Upload a statement. Parsed and staged, writes nothing yet |
| GET | `/api/import/batches` | Staged and committed import batches |
| GET \| POST \| DELETE | `/api/import/batch/{id}` | Read, commit or discard a staged batch |
| PATCH | `/api/import/row/{id}` | Edit one staged row before committing |
| POST | `/api/import/batch/{id}/revert` | Undo a committed import |

## Settings and themes — session + CSRF

Secrets are write-only: the API reports whether one is set, never its value.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET \| PATCH | `/api/settings` | Read settings, or change them. Secrets are write-only |
| DELETE | `/api/settings/{key}` | Clear one setting |
| GET | `/api/google/check` | Whether Google is configured and reachable |
| GET | `/api/google/connect` | Begin connecting an additional Google account |
| GET | `/api/google/accounts` | Connected Google accounts |
| DELETE | `/api/google/accounts/{id}` | Disconnect an account and delete its tokens |
| GET \| POST | `/api/themes` | Installed themes, or import one |
| POST \| DELETE | `/api/themes/{id}` | Activate or delete a theme |

## Saving — session + CSRF

A savings plan built from your own months. Every target is a figure your statements show you have already spent, and fixed costs are left alone. The model sets how movable a category is; it never produces, adjusts or sees a number.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/view/savings` | What each category could cost instead of what it does, with the total it frees up |
| POST | `/api/savings/classify` | Sort unclassified categories by how movable they are. Sends names only, once each |
| PATCH | `/api/savings/flexibility/{id}` | Correct one category's flexibility. Yours is never overwritten by the model |
| POST | `/api/savings/apply/{month}` | Set this month's budget to the plan's targets, for the categories you name |

## Sync — session + CSRF

The same work the background scheduler does, on demand.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/action/sync` | Run a Google sync (Sync now button) |

## Ingest — ingest key

For an external scheduler. Closed unless you set an ingest key, and it opens no route that can read or edit your data. Ingest is idempotent: re-posting the same payload repairs rather than duplicates.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/ingest/events` | Calendar events, upserted by (account, source_uid) |
| POST | `/api/ingest/messages` | Mail with importance, upserted by (account, source_uid) |
| POST | `/api/ingest/sync` | Trigger a sync |
| POST | `/api/sync/google` | Run a Google sync (ingest key) |
